notes: The Studio site symlinks this repo in as wp-content/plugins/courier-notices, so edits are live.
Studio runs PHP-WASM: paths inside `wp eval` must use ABSPATH (resolves to /wordpress/), never host filesystem paths.
Studio is not a PHPUnit host. PHP unit tests are WordPress-free; integration tests run in CI against wp-phpunit + MySQL.
See docs/2.0-MIGRATION-PLAN.md for the 2.0 architecture and phasing.
